text: The Hōretireti Whenua – Sliding Lands programme is a five-year initiative funded by the MBIE Endeavour Fund, aimed at developing national-scale models to predict and manage landslide hazards in New Zealand. The programme integrates scientific research, socio-economic analysis, and mātauranga Māori to create decision-relevant tools for forecasting landslides triggered by earthquakes and rainfall. It involves a consortium of research institutions, iwi, government, and industry partners, with case studies in Tairāwhiti and Auckland to test its effectiveness.
